summary: Revised implementation plan addressing all user review comments: (1) Universal multi-check respec & build-duration engine for ALL citizens across every country (combining fresh API skill hydration, API lastSkillsResetAt, individual skill-level decrease / SP-redistribution fingerprint checks, and recent combat activity vs. current Eco build heuristics); (2) Non-deletable permanent RespecAlert & build-transition history executed automatically across all syncs and background streams; (3) Exact War Era Level 50 cap + Prestige SP math (max level is 50 granting 200 base SP + Prestige points that ignore skill caps; fusing Leadership into Management in Hotfix 0.27.3 drops the 3 workforce skills from an impossible 220 SP to 165 SP max, freeing 35+ SP plus Prestige points for high Production in Levels 26–50); and (4) 100% Spanish localization for Active Window and dynamic fiscal classification strings.
